correctness.rationale: Exact conditional identity Cov(V,H)=(1-θ/2)^L[Lθ²/(2-θ)-E|D|]. For K~Bin(L,θ), walk absolute-value recurrence and size bias give E|D|=Lθ E[h(1+Bin(L-1,θ))]. Central binomial h is decreasing, strictly from 1 to 1/2; θ/(2-θ) is increasing, establishing precisely one crossing. Lindeberg CLT with uniform integrability at θ=cL^{-1/3} and sign bracketing proves limit (8/π)^{1/3}. Exact independent enumeration through L=7 and 273 checker assertions support the proof.

value.rationale: Vacancy and peak occupancy are natural competing loading diagnostics. Their covariance can have either sign; the theorem gives the complete dependence phase diagram uniformly for all finite potential workloads and the sharp cube-root critical retention scaling. This is a nontrivial structural sign characterization not a small arithmetic correction.
